title: Hailey our guide was...
text:
Hailey our guide was amazing! She was punctual, informative, knowledgeable and fun !
She took us around the gothic quarters and pointed out a lot of interesting facts.
author: Suzette_Z

title: Gothic Quarter Tour Experience
text: We were a party of 3 and only members in the group. The best part was that Chassie did arrive on time and went through on great length and detail to give us a wonderful tour experience. The tour was 2 hours and we started and ended on time. We also got ample time to take pictures and it was not a rushed through event. We would recommend this to anyone wanting to take this tour. There are some details that one might miss when doing it alone versus the experience you would get in an interactive tour. Thank you so much.
author: Alay_T

title: Wonderful tour
text: Marcel, our guide, was fabulous. We were new to Barcelona but attempted to get some background before our visit. His stops, predominantly historical included light hearted cultural spots (sports, holiday, and current events). A highlight of a 4 day visit
author: Callie_O

title: Personalized tour
text: My wife and I were the only ones on the tour. Guide very knowledgeable. Enjoyed the tour and would recommend!
author: James_S

title: Fantastic tour with a great guide.
text: Jekaterina was a fantastic guide for our 2 hour walking tour of the Gothic Tour. Very knowledgable and engaging. My family really enjoyed the tour and learnt loads about the history of Barcelona. Would definitely recommend booking the tour.
author: ian m

title: Gothic Quarter
text: Our tour guide was excellent Great information and wonderful sense of humour. He is extremely highly recommended
author: Elaine_K

title: Great tour!
text: It was a great experience. Our guide, Katharina, was very knowledgeable, spoke perfect English and took us on the very interesting tour in this beautiful part of Barcelona. Providing a lot of details. We all agree it's time and money well spent.
author: 552radekl

title: Great tour guide!!!
text: We did this tour on our first night in Barcelona.  We loved it!  Patricio was very knowledgeable and gave us a great history of Barcelona while weaving us through the streets of the Gothic Quarter.  I highly recommend this tour!!
author: Julia_S

title: Great tour with Patrick.
text: Patrick was a terrific guide.  Enthusiastic and very knowledgeable.  Well worth a private tour with Patrick.  A Brit expat experienced living in the area.  Good fun for me.  Felt like I was with a buddy.  Sharp man.
author: William_M
